description_en: Queries the log of an SSL server
description_zh: 调用DescribeVpnSslServerLogs接口查看SSL服务端的日志
kebab_example: aliyun vpc describe-vpn-ssl-server-logs --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --vpn-ssl-server-id vss-bp155e9yclsg1xgq40000 --ssl-vpn-client-cert-id vsc-m5euof6s5jy8vs5kd0000 --from 1600738962 --to 1600738962 --minute-period 10 --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeVpnSslServerLogs

parameters.description_en: The ID of the region where the SSL server is created. You can call the [DescribeRegions](~~36063~~) operation to query the most recent region list.
parameters.description_zh: SSL服务端所在的地域ID。您可以通过调用[DescribeRegions](~~36063~~)接口获取地域ID。

parameters.description_en: The ID of the SSL server.

parameters.description_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate.
parameters.help_en: The ID of the SSL client certificate
parameters.name: ssl_vpn_client_cert_id

parameters.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value must be a unix timestamp. For example, 1600738962 specifies 09:42:42 (UTC+8) on September 22, 2020.

>  If you specify **From**, you must also specify **To** or **MinutePeriod**.
parameters.description_zh:
日志起始时间，仅支持传入UNIX秒级时间戳，例如1600738962，1600738962表示的时间为2020年09月22日09:42:42。

> 如果指定**From**，则必须指定**To**或**MinutePeriod**。

parameters.description_en:
The interval at which log data is queried. Unit: minutes.
